releases.notes: Every position carries one identity on both radios; V3 keeps room for Bluetooth beside Wi-Fi

Build 36: 4 s button hold powers off, positions stamped and expired on the radio, dropped writes named, radio always reports its firmware. Flash every radio in the group and update the Touge app: it needs build 36.
Build 34: Bluetooth batches stay bounded through long stalls, delayed positions no longer look fresh, write losses counted only when the radio reports them. Flash every radio in the group.

Build 33: hold the button 3 s to switch off; small groups beacon up to 4 times a second; fixes fast-lane positions being treated as 65 s old. Flash every radio in the group. Needs the matching Touge app.
Build 30: 32 leased slots for 25+ cars, batched positions to the phone, Link diagnostics. Flash every radio in the group: build 30 only hears older radios over LoRa. Needs the matching Touge app.
Build 29: steady 1 Hz fast lane, no dropped positions to the phone, speed and heading reach the phone in Meshtastic's units. Needs the matching Touge app.
Build 28: Bluetooth link recovers from a dark radio (advertising restart), the radio's GPS fix goes to the phone, a V4 with no GNSS stops probing on boot, GNSS speed fixed
First public release: fast lane on fixed deadlines, BLE memory fix for the V3, 2.4 GHz rate reporting
